recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 EBER 原位雜交中，數個大型細胞核呈深藍色強陽性訊號，周圍小細胞為紅色對比染色陰性；陽性的是大型腫瘤細胞而非零星小淋巴球，支持 EBV 陽性 CHL。
features: Scattered large nuclei with strong dark blue nuclear EBER signal
Some positive nuclei lobated or paired, consistent with Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells
Background small cells negative with pink nuclear fast red counterstain
Positive cells occur singly, not in sheets; bony trabecula at lower center
describe_en: EBV-encoded RNA (EBER) in situ hybridization on a bone marrow biopsy shows strong nuclear signal in scattered large cells, some with lobated or paired nuclei, distributed singly within the infiltrate adjacent to a bony trabecula. The background small lymphocytes and stromal cells are negative. The positive cells correspond in size and distribution to the Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells seen on H&E and CD30 stains. Findings indicate EBV-positive classic Hodgkin lymphoma involving the marrow.

ddx.vs: EBV+ DLBCL shows numerous EBER+ large cells often in sheets that are CD20+ with strong PAX5, rather than scattered CD20−, CD15+ HRS cells.

ddx.dx: Latent EBV in bystander small B cells
ddx.vs: Bystander EBV-positive cells are rare, small lymphocytes, whereas here the signal is in large atypical nuclei.

ddx.dx: Peripheral T-cell lymphoma (e.g. AITL) with EBV+ B-immunoblasts
ddx.vs: AITL has EBER+ B immunoblasts of variable size amid a neoplastic CD10+/PD-1+ T-cell population with high endothelial venule proliferation.
